attr.title: Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed
attr.desc: Experimental ARM64 static-recompilation port of Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed (2000, v3.2) for Anbernic H700 handhelds. DirectDraw7/Direct3D7 is translated to OpenGL ES 2.0; SDL2 handles window/input/audio. Players supply their own game files (folder, ZIP or CD image); the native launcher unpacks and verifies them, with no Python or unzip needed on device. Native settings UI (frame cap, detail, resolution, aspect, controller mapping). Desktop is playable up to a drivable Quick Race; handheld performance is not yet qualified.
attr.inst: Extract nfs5.zip into the device's ports folder (not the SD-card root). Put your own game files into nfs5/source/: the installed game folder, a .zip of it, or a CD image (.iso, .bin + .cue, or .mdf + .mds). The native launcher unpacks the image/zip with built-in code, verifies what it finds, copies the game into nfs5/data/ (allow ~1.5 GiB free) and opens the settings menu (frame cap, detail, resolution, aspect, controller mapping). Player data is kept beside the binaries in nfs5/saves/ and nfs5/configs/. Then launch NFS5. Requires AArch64 firmware with glibc 2.36+, SDL2, SDL2_ttf and libmali.so.0. Device FPS and full gameplay are not yet qualified on H700.
